----------------------
-- CREATE CREDENTIAL
----------------------
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL dineshcreds
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'


----------------------
-- CREATE EXT DATA SOURCE
----------------------

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://dineshdatalakeacname.dfs.core.windows.net/raw',
    CREDENTIAL = dineshcreds
)

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source_abfss
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'abfss://raw@dineshdatalakeacname.dfs.core.windows.net',
    CREDENTIAL = dineshcreds
)


-------------------------------
--CREATE PARQUET FILE FORMAT
-------------------------------
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE  FORMAT parquet_format
WITH (
        FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
        DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
)
